pkgmetadata.longdescription:
OpenAI's official Electron desktop application for Linux, published under the Codex brand. It bundles ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and the Codex coding agent in a single window; the Codex CLI, a private Node.js runtime and ripgrep are shipped inside the payload.
This is proprietary, closed-source software distributed only as a prebuilt binary: nothing here is compiled from source, the package is neither mirrored nor redistributable in binary form, and using it requires an OpenAI account. Upstream calls the installed command "chatgpt", which is why the package name and the binary name differ.
Upstream has no changelog or release feed; new builds are only discoverable via a rolling "latest" alias. SRC_URI here uses the immutable version-pinned pool path instead, so PV always matches the exact bytes it fetches. Run update.sh to check for and adopt a newer build (it bumps PV and regenerates the Manifest).
Note that the Linux build has no setuid sandbox helper and depends on unprivileged user namespaces for renderer isolation.

use.flag: Install the upstream AppArmor profile, which grants the app the user-namespace access its renderer sandbox needs
Use EGL for smooth rendering on high refresh rate monitors
Run in wayland mode under wayland sessions, xwayland otherwise. This flag doesn't affect x11 sessions.
